articles.summary: DUBUQUE, Iowa --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 20, 2025-- Flexsteel Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ: FLXS) (“Flexsteel” or the “Company”), one of the largest manufacturers, importers, and marketers of residential furniture products in the United States , today reported first quarter fiscal 2026 results.
articles.title: Flexsteel Industries, Inc. Reports Strong Fiscal First Quarter 2026 Results
